articles.title: A Tiny Red Plant With a Death Hug
articles.summary: A tiny red plant that hugs insects to death is now its own species, living in one small part of Florida.

articles.title: A Forgotten Particle May Explain Why the Universe Exists
articles.summary: A forgotten particle may have tipped the young universe in favor of matter, scientists propose.

articles.title: A Tiny Motor Inspired by an Ancient Screw
articles.summary: A molecule-sized screw spins on electricity, reverses on command, and carries electricity far better while turning.
